subject: Geografia
description_pt: Descrever o ciclo da água, comparando o escoamento superficial no ambiente urbano e rural, reconhecendo os principais componentes da morfologia das bacias e das redes hidrográficas e a sua localização no modelado da superfície terrestre e da cobertura vegetal.

components.description_pt: Explicar os papéis de evaporação, transpiração, condensação, precipitação e escoamento no ciclo da água
components.description_en: Explain the roles of evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, and surface flow in the water cycle
components.cc_component_description: Explain the roles of evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, and surface flow in the water cycle

components.description_pt: Comparar processos de escoamento superficial em ambientes urbanos e rurais
components.description_en: Compare surface runoff processes in urban and rural environments
components.cc_component_description: Analyze data collected to explain how water drives surface processes such as erosion, weathering, or runoff

components.description_pt: Identificar componentes principais da morfologia de bacias hidrográficas e redes hidrográficas
components.description_en: Identify principal components of drainage basin morphology and hydrographic networks

components.description_pt: Localizar redes hidrográficas dentro do relevo terrestre e da cobertura vegetal
components.description_en: Locate hydrographic networks within Earth's landform relief and vegetation cover

cc_matches.description: Water continually cycles among land, ocean, and atmosphere via transpiration, evaporation, condensation and crystallization, and precipitation, as well as downhill flows on land.
Plan and conduct an investigation of the properties of water and its effects on Earth materials and surface processes.
